capabilities: render a zk-index graph view from keyword index files
render a zk-local graph view from a note's ID
support Luhmann, Folgezettel, and Antinet ID styles
choose which field (filename, metadata, or filename prefix) holds the note ID
pan and zoom the generated Mermaid graphs
extras: The README links to a separate Chinese-language version, and graph generation requires users to already maintain Luhmann-style IDs and keyword index files in their vault.
intentEvidence: I don't find any note-taking apps or plugins provide the graph view functionality basing on Luhmann-style IDs
motivation: The author could not find any note-taking app or plugin that provides graph views based on Luhmann-style note IDs and his keyword index, and built this plugin to fill that gap.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows only link-based relations, so the ordered structure encoded in Luhmann-style IDs and keyword indexes is invisible and chains of thought become hard to trace.
summary: Graph-view plugin that renders Mermaid-based index and local graphs of a zettelkasten from Luhmann-style note IDs and keyword indexes.
